message: //lib/empty has a testing/ directory and no `testing` block

location.text: # An empty `testing {}` is accepted: the block says the surface exists, and

fix: add a `testing { }` block to the library rule in lib/empty/BUILD.buri — empty if the entry point is the whole of it — or delete the directory
notes: the block is what puts the surface in the build; without it nothing compiles testing/lib.buri and no dependent can name it
